question: Can a constrained rank-one resid18 is/was writer retain held-out A effects while suppressing the temporal-paraphrase nuisance that invalidated the unconstrained direction, and if so is it the already identified has/had carrier?

searched: circuits/prior_art and circuits/followups for selective rank-one, nuisance-constrained, and projected-gradient fits
the 08:30 mathematical review and current Agent Board
novelty_search.nearest_result: tense_auxiliary.is_vs_was.das_resid18_rank1_transfer_v1 is a valid null with strong A but P disturbance 0.644/0.659; it did not optimize a registered selectivity constraint.
novelty_search.new_question: Distinguish an A-correlated nuisance direction from a genuinely selective is/was writer, then test shared-writer geometry and reciprocal transfer conditionally.
novelty_search.anti_rank_drift: Rank remains exactly one. No rank, penalty, threshold, seed, row, or step sweep is permitted, and a null cannot authorize higher rank. The result changes selective-manipulation and reuse/grouping evidence rather than compression.

frozen_design.optimizer: One 600-step final-head-only Adam run at lr=0.05. QR normalizes q each step. Twelve fixed 50-step augmented-Lagrangian blocks use rho=[1,1,2,2,4,4,8,8,16,16,32,32]; nonnegative P/C multipliers update only at block boundaries.
frozen_design.fit_target: First eight v2 A1 rows minimize donor-margin squared error normalized by the frozen A target scale squared.
frozen_design.fit_constraints: First eight v2 P and first eight v2 C rows each constrain mean absolute projected-intervention response divided by the frozen A target scale to <=0.10.
tests: last eight v2 P and C
frozen_design.conditional_shared_writer_test: Only if own-task A/P/C gates pass: compare absolute cosine to the frozen has/had q and apply q_is by projected interchange to all has/had v5 A1/A2/P/C rows without refitting.
frozen_design.toy_gate: Before GPU execution, a deterministic CPU toy must show that the exact optimizer selects a planted shared actuator over an A-correlated nuisance direction and that removing constraints recovers the nuisance mixture.

predictions.pred_a_authority_toy_head_and_rank: All hashes/capability authorities, CPU toy, exact-head <=1e-3, q shape 1152x1, rank one, and fixed optimizer tripwires pass.
predictions.pred_b_heldout_is_was_a: Held-out v2 A1, v2 A2, v3 A1, and v3 A2 absolute recovery are each >=0.50.
predictions.pred_c_heldout_is_was_selectivity: Held-out v2 and all-v3 P/C normalized disturbances are each <=0.20.
predictions.pred_d_shared_writer_geometry: Conditional on B-C passing, absolute cosine with frozen q_has is >=0.50.
predictions.pred_e_reciprocal_has_had_transfer: Conditional on B-C passing, has/had v5 A1 and A2 absolute recovery are each >=0.25 while P/C disturbance are each <=0.20.
predictions.pred_f_exact_coverage: At most 27 model forwards, 392 example evaluations, 600 final-head-only gradient steps, 1152 fit scalars, zero transformer backwards and zero model updates.

opposing_outcomes.shared_selective_writer: B-C pass and D-E pass: group one selective actuator across output vocabularies while retaining distinct upstream readers.
opposing_outcomes.one_way_shared_sensitivity: B-C pass but cosine <=0.20 and reciprocal A1/A2 <=0.20: is/was can observe q_has, but its independently controllable selective writer differs.
opposing_outcomes.no_selective_rank1_writer: Any own-task A cell is <0.50 or any held-out P is >0.20: preserve the rank-one null and do not raise rank.
opposing_outcomes.intermediate: Other valid combinations are reported as inconclusive, without threshold or rank repair.

terminal.screen: A-C and F pass; a selective rank-one is/was writer is identified, with D-E separately scoring shared-writer reuse.
terminal.null: A and F pass but own-task recovery or selectivity misses; do not raise rank.
terminal.invalid: Authority, capability, toy, exact-head, optimizer-tripwire, rank, or coverage failure.
